_meta.purpose: Blind side-by-side reference set for the Meridian gauntlet (light-mode enterprise SaaS / AI-agent sites).
_meta.rules: Light-mode captures preferred. Every file verified present, > 30KB, and visually inspected (not blank, not cookie-walled). Excluded on purpose: linear (dark theme), rippling home (dark plum + chat popup), writer home (black), deel home (cookie wall), glean (Osano cookie wall on every page), sana (blocked capture), workday security/customers (broken captures), mercury home-full (scroll-driven sections do not paint), stripe security (actually the dark enterprise page).

hero.why: Left-aligned 2-col hero: live eyebrow counter, 6-word H1 with two-tone run-in sentence, filled + outline CTA pair, WebGL ribbon bleeding off-canvas, logo bar at the fold line.
Centered hero, 4-word H1 at 64px, one-line grey sub, outline + black CTA pair, full-width product window with the agent prompt. Calmest black/white/hairline system in the set.
Small-caps live eyebrow, 5-word declarative H1, email + lime CTA, product card on dotted grid, sticky bottom 'AGENTS AT WORK TODAY' ticker with live counters.
Textbook hierarchy: G2 eyebrow, 4-word 72px H1, one-line sub, single email form, proof ticker, category pills switching a large product UI. HR buyer context.
Two-col hero with 5-word H1, one-line sub, inline email form, 'See in action' text link; 3D product still with the card + phone. One orange accent.
Serif display H1 (4 words, 2 lines) paired with a sans sub and single black CTA on the right; full-width product dashboard framed in a textured panel. Premium enterprise-AI tone.
Editorial hero on warm paper: oversized sans H1 with underlined words, serif mission paragraph, no CTA; one full-width photo card. Restraint benchmark.

home-full.why: Full funnel sequence: hero, logos, product-UI bento, stats band, segmented customer stories with metrics, developer band, integration paths, closing split CTA, mega footer.
Hero, logos, 5-tab product tour, dark feature band, integrations row, single large quote, 4 stats, logos + photo, changelog, footer. Hairline and dotted-grid discipline throughout.
Agents-for-every-workflow bento, alternating story blocks that name the agent that did the work, testimonial wall, closing CTA. Live numbers everywhere.
HR platform sequence with tabs by company size, compliance band, AI assistant section, inline pricing, implementation timeline. Closest buyer to Meridian's HR side.
Finance platform sequence: product pillars, controls story, customer proof, closing CTA. Single accent, product UI as proof.
Short (3 screens) editorial page: hero, feature card, 3 release cards with DATE / CATEGORY meta rows, mission + link list, black footer. Benchmark for brevity.
AI-agent vendor sequence: cinematic hero, logo grid, outcome cards (Pay for a job well done), quote cards, agent-building agent, trust badge row, CTA.

Two-card Standard (white, take-rate) vs Custom (dark navy, negotiated) on hairline guide columns, then a sticky in-page tab bar (Standard / Custom / FAQs).
Three cards with tab-style labels above them (AI-assisted / AI-powered / AI-tailored), middle card ringed in lime, per-card email field + CTA, then grouped feature lists.
Single bordered COMPARE PLANS container with an Annual (15% off) toggle, three columns, filled button only on the entry tier, Jump-to-section links, 'Everything in X, plus' lists.
Centered 2-line H1, logo row as trust, three white cards on grey canvas with per-user price, full-width orange CTA, 'Everything in X plus' check lists.
Left-aligned 2-line H1 'Scale your app, control your costs'; three hairline-divided columns, huge price numerals, 'Popular' chip, usage credit named as a line item, icon check lists, pill CTAs.
Serif 'Pricing' title, 3-segment control (Individual / Team & Enterprise / API), three cards with line-art glyphs, black full-width CTAs. Warm palette.

Mono caps eyebrow, centered H1 with one italic word, one-line sub, inline email form, large product UI in a laptop frame with a phone overlay.
Centered H1 + sub + email form + Contact sales, product dashboard in a soft gradient mat; the regulatory disclosure as a floating pill.

Grid-paper canvas with crosshair corners, speech-bubble H1 block, two-tone sentence headline, pill CTA, then feature rows in hairline cells.
Agent System of Record page: product sub-nav (Overview / Agents / Pricing / Responsible AI), caps eyebrow, H1 'People and agents working hand in hand.', video with play, Play Demo + Read Blog.

Left-aligned 'Customer stories', two black-and-white video cards with one-sentence outcome captions, carousel progress bar.
CUSTOMERS eyebrow, serif H1 with an italic word, demo CTA, hero video card + tinted logo card, logo row, filter pills (Industry / Department / Use case / Feature), tinted case-study cards.
